name: Craft for Education
summary: Free Craft education plan for verified students, with unlimited documents and up to 250 GB storage.
who: Currently enrolled students at an academic institution.
how: Register with your school email and click the activation link Craft emails you.
catches: Confirm the plan's price on the page.

evidence.quote: currently enrolled student, faculty or staff member of an academic institution
Your verification will be valid for 12 months, after which you’ll need to re-verify your status.
We believe education should be accessible to everyone, and that's why we offer Craft for free to students and educators.
